templates.name: AI Recipe: Original Agent Persona
templates.description: Claude invents one original, debate-ready character in a rotating archetype group and writes a portable second-person persona card any model can adopt, with an illustrated portrait cover.

templates.name: AI Recipe: Agent Toolkit
templates.description: Claude researches 24+ things to install into an LLM or coding agent — skills, commands, MCP servers, plugins, hooks, harnesses — half proven, half new. Exports browser-importable bookmarks.

templates.name: AI Recipe: AI Meme
templates.description: Claude invents one original AI-and-tech-themed meme in a rotating theme, never a copied template or a real person, and the runner renders it square with the caption baked in. Optional idea queue via meme-ideas.md.

templates.name: AI Recipe: AI Stack Radar
templates.description: Claude researches 24+ hosted AI products, sorted into buckets by the job they do, each with what it replaces and what it costs. Dedups against every earlier run; exports browser-importable bookmarks.

templates.name: AI Recipe: Weekly Alternate History
templates.description: Claude writes an eight-section "what if" timeline from one real historical divergence, with scene-by-scene illustration prompts and a portrait cover. Optional premise queue via alt-history-ideas.md.

templates.name: AI Recipe: Weekly Comic
templates.description: Claude writes a four-panel comic strip in a rotating topic — script with dialogue, original fictional characters only — and the runner renders the full-page strip with short balloon lettering.

templates.name: AI Recipe: Content Idea
templates.description: Claude researches what is working on social platforms in a rotating topic area and pitches one automatable content series — hook, treatment, automation angle, sources — with a cover.

templates.name: AI Recipe: Cool Websites
templates.description: Claude finds and verifies 28+ genuinely useful, lesser-known websites across 8–12 categories, never repeating an earlier run. Exports browser-importable bookmarks.

templates.name: AI Recipe: Daily App Idea Card
templates.description: Claude researches a current trend and writes a one-page app pitch (problem, user, MVP, monetization, risks, sources) with a concept-art cover. Rotates across five categories so the backlog stays balanced.

templates.name: AI Recipe: Daily Poster
templates.description: Claude designs a vertical poster on the next least-used of 200 themes — art movements, nature, science, space, myth, architecture — and the runner renders it at 2:3.

templates.name: AI Recipe: Finance Toolkit
templates.description: Claude researches 22+ financial tools — market-data APIs, backtesting, broker SDKs, ledgers, finance AI — with verified free-tier caps. Never investment advice. Exports browser-importable bookmarks.

templates.name: AI Recipe: Future Cities 2500
templates.description: Claude imagines a real city 475 years forward — landmarks, climate adaptation, transport, a named colour grade — and the runner renders one cinematic 16:9 cityscape.

templates.name: AI Recipe: Icon Pack
templates.description: Claude designs a cohesive pack of 12 icons and draws each symbol as SVG; code adds an identical container to all twelve and ships SVG, transparent 1024 px PNG and multi-size ICO. No image model involved.

templates.name: AI Recipe: Weekly Image Prompt Pack
templates.description: Claude writes a themed pack of 5–8 reusable, copy-ready image prompts — negative prompts, aspect ratios, style tags, use cases — and every prompt gets a rendered example image.

templates.name: AI Recipe: Open-Source Spotlight
templates.description: Pulls seven open-source news feeds, then Claude writes a six-section editorial read on the period — releases, community news, hidden gems — graded by significance.

templates.name: AI Recipe: Podcast Script
templates.description: Claude writes a 1,500–3,000-word AI-vs-AI debate podcast episode as a speaker-labelled transcript, with a fictional cast (or your own recurring cast cards) and an optional topic queue, plus a square cover. Pair it with the Audio Podcast recipe.

templates.name: AI Recipe: Recipe of the Week
templates.description: Claude researches a well-loved family dish from a rotating cuisine and writes a cookable recipe with complete allergen labeling, gated by a food-safety scanner, plus a cover and a self-contained Cook's Card page.

templates.name: AI Recipes: Update Clone
templates.description: Fast-forward your ai-automation-recipes clone daily so every scheduled recipe runs the latest prompts and skills. Pairs with any AI Recipe template.

templates.name: AI Recipe: Security Toolkit
templates.description: Claude researches 24+ security tools across identity, detection, recon, AppSec, cloud and labs, with licences stated. Tools, never targets. Exports browser-importable bookmarks.

templates.name: AI Recipe: Serialized Novella
templates.description: Claude writes the next chapter of an ongoing novel against its story bible — inventing the bible on the first run — keeping continuity through a rolling synopsis and the latest chapters, with a chapter illustration.

templates.name: AI Recipe: Signal Sources
templates.description: Claude adds 12+ blogs, newsletters, changelogs and channels worth following to a cumulative reading list, each with a verified feed. Regenerates an all-time bookmarks file and an OPML bundle.

templates.name: AI Recipe: Song
templates.description: Claude writes an original song in the type you choose — weekly news song, rock, country, rap, psychedelic, folk, jazz and more, most with a comedy twin — as lyrics plus an ElevenLabs composition plan, then the runner renders the MP3 and a square cover. Needs ELEVENLABS_API_KEY; each run spends music credits.

templates.name: AI Recipe: Top 10 GitHub Repos
templates.description: Fetches GitHub Trending's weekly feeds, then Claude ranks the ten strongest AI and developer-tooling repos with what is driving each. Exports browser-importable bookmarks.

templates.name: AI Recipe: Trending Movers
templates.description: Scrapes GitHub's weekly trending pages for stars gained, then Claude writes a star-velocity leaderboard in the measured order. Published figures are checked against the measurements.

templates.name: AI Recipe: Voiceover Script
templates.description: Claude researches a real-world story and writes a 90–180-second narration with direction notes; the runner narrates it with a preset voice and, with ffmpeg, cuts a vertical short from generated scene stills.

templates.name: AI Recipe: Weekly Wallpaper Pack
templates.description: Three themed wallpapers from a rotating pool of twelve, each with a random lighting, palette, mood and framing twist, delivered as a matching 16:9 desktop and 9:16 phone pair cropped from one render.

templates.name: AI Recipe: Yearly Collections
templates.description: Advances every long-running image collection by one researched entry — Science Breakthroughs year by year, Technology Milestones, Exoplanets, or your own — configured in an editable collections.json.

templates.name: AI Recipe: 3D Print Idea
templates.description: Claude researches what sells and writes one original FDM-printable product design — README spec, machine-readable design-spec.json, sources and a product mockup — precise enough to model in CAD.

templates.name: AI Recipe: Weekly AI Map
templates.description: Claude researches 8–20 real places on a rotating theme and builds a standalone interactive Leaflet map with categories, popups and directions links, plus a companion guide, sources, and a cover.

templates.name: AI Recipe: Weekly App Prototype
templates.description: Claude researches a current trend and builds a runnable single-page app prototype — README pitch, requirements, HTML/CSS/JS and sample data — with a concept-art cover. Opens from file://, no build step.

templates.name: AI Recipe: Audio Podcast
templates.description: Renders the oldest unrendered podcast script to an episode: Claude casts a preset voice per speaker and writes show notes, then every line is spoken with Gemini or ElevenLabs text-to-speech. Exits cleanly when there's nothing to render.

templates.name: AI Recipe: Weekly Browser Extension
templates.description: Claude researches a current pain point and builds a loadable Manifest V3 extension plus a mock-browser demo that shares the popup's code — README pitch, requirements, permissions table — with a concept-art cover. Structure and scripts are checked before publishing.

templates.name: AI Recipe: Weekly Browser Game
templates.description: Claude designs and builds a complete single-file HTML game in a rotating genre — playable from file://, touch-aware, syntax-checked before it is published — with a design brief and key-art cover.

templates.name: AI Recipe: Financial Idea
templates.description: Claude builds a runnable personal-finance app prototype (budgeting, saving, rewards, debt, investing tools…) on synthetic data, rotating themes so the catalogue stays balanced. Educational tooling, not advice.

templates.name: AI Recipe: Weekly Funny AI Content
templates.description: Claude writes one satirical content concept about an absurd AI-agent use case — the bit, script beats, the fake automation angle — with a wordless cover gag.

templates.name: AI Recipe: Weekly Mobile Game
templates.description: Claude designs and builds a portrait, touch-first phone game as one HTML file inside an on-screen phone frame, in a rotating genre — syntax-checked before publishing — with a design brief and key art.

templates.name: AI Recipe: Weekly PC Game Concept
templates.description: Claude researches this week's genre and writes an original PC game concept — a design brief with a buildable core loop and 6-week prototype plan, a one-page pitch, sources and key art.

templates.name: AI Recipe: Weekly Regional Recipe
templates.description: Claude adds one authentic dish a week to a regional recipe library, always filling the region with the fewest recipes. Food-safety gated, with a cover and a Cook's Card page.

templates.name: AI Recipe: Weekly Short Story
templates.description: Claude writes a complete 2,000–4,000-word short story in a rotating genre, avoiding every premise already written, with a portrait cover illustration. Optional idea queue via story-ideas.md.

packs.name: AI Content Recipes
packs.description: Every recipe: scheduled Claude Code automations that research, write, build and illustrate into a folder you can browse.

packs.name: AI Recipes: Apps & Games
packs.description: Idea cards, runnable app and extension prototypes, playable games, game and 3D-print concepts.

packs.name: AI Recipes: Writing
packs.description: Short stories, a serialized novella, alternate histories, original characters and content ideas.

packs.name: AI Recipes: Food & Maps
packs.description: Safety-checked recipes with a printable Cook's Card, and researched interactive maps.

packs.name: AI Recipes: Research Digests
packs.description: Monthly researched roundups — AI tools, agent tooling, open source, security and finance tooling, trending repos, useful sites and reading lists — with browser bookmarks.

packs.name: AI Recipes: Images
packs.description: Comics, memes, posters, cityscapes, prompt packs, paired desktop and phone wallpapers, SVG icon packs and long-running yearly image collections.

packs.name: AI Recipes: Audio
packs.description: Songs composed from AI-written lyrics, a two-step debate podcast, and narrated voiceover shorts — preset voices only.
